title: TaxAnn Annotation Set
description: A reusable, taxpayer-agnostic description of how to print values onto the boxes of a U.S. tax form. Contains ZERO taxpayer data.

taxYear.description: Tax year the form applies to.

sourcePdf.description: Filename of the blank source PDF these coordinates were authored against.

origin.description: Where (0,0) sits and which way y grows. Authoring default is top-left (y grows downward), matching how a human reads a rendered page. The renderer converts to the PDF-native bottom-left system.

height.description: Page height in points; needed to flip the y-axis.

styles.description: Named, reusable presentation styles referenced by fields. Define once, reuse everywhere.

size.description: Font size in points (may be reduced by overflow policy 'shrink').

valueBinding.description: How to obtain the value for a field. Exactly one of 'ref', 'template', or 'const' must be present.

ref.description: A restricted JSONPath expression that MUST resolve to exactly one node in the taxpayer data. Supports dot and [index] navigation, e.g. '$.income.w2[0].box1'. Multi-match expressions are a validation error in v1.0.

template.description: A string with {$.path} placeholders, each resolving to a single node, e.g. '{$.address.city}, {$.address.state} {$.address.zip}'.

const.description: A literal constant value (rarely needed; useful for fixed marks).

transform.description: A single transform from a fixed, closed enum. No arbitrary code is ever evaluated.

default.description: Value to use when the ref resolves to null/undefined/missing. If absent and value is missing, the field renders blank.

decimals.description: Decimal places. IRS whole-dollar lines use 0.

negative.description: Render negatives as -1234 or (1234). Tax forms use 'parens'.

source.description: Provenance / migration anchor. The stable PDF AcroForm field id this box was authored from. Enables (a) year-over-year re-anchoring and (b) an optional AcroForm-native render path.

id.description: Human-meaningful semantic id assigned by the annotator, e.g. 'taxpayer_first_name'.

style.description: Name of a style in the top-level 'styles' map.

overflow.description: What to do when the rendered value does not fit the box. Default 'shrink'.

comb.description: For type 'comb': distribute one value across N evenly spaced cells.

groupGaps.description: Extra visual gap (pt) BEFORE the cell index given by the key. e.g. {"3":6,"5":6} for SSN grouping.

mark.description: For 'checkbox'/'choiceGroup': the glyph to stamp when selected. Default 'X'.

options.description: For 'choiceGroup': the mutually exclusive options. The field's resolved value selects exactly one 'when'.
